# Test Fixtures

## paper_quotes.json

This file must be created manually from the paper text.
Use `pdftotext -enc UTF-8 paper.pdf - | ...` or copy-paste the relevant passages.

Format (JSON array):
```json
[
  {
    "id": "A1",
    "quote": "extracted from the final hidden state of the special [CLS] token generated by BERT",
    "source": "Section III-A"
  },
  {
    "id": "A13_gb",
    "quote": "100 decision trees, a learning rate of 0.1, and a maximum depth of 3",
    "source": "Section IV-D"
  }
]
```

If this file is absent, `test_registry_quotes.py::test_paper_quotes_present_in_registry`
is skipped (not failed). All other tests in that file run unconditionally.
